avatars.name: Sprout
avatars.about: A seedling with a leaf that sways. Rounded shapes and gentle shading, like the plaza.

avatars.name: Pip
avatars.about: A faceted fox with a bouncy tail. Flat facets, hard cel shading and bold outlines.

avatars.name: Inky
avatars.about: A doodle off a handwritten page. Brush outlines, cross-hatched shadows and inked hands.

avatars.name: Bolt

avatars.name: Polybot
avatars.about: A friendly low-poly robot from Polygonal Mind's 100Avatars collection, free to use (CC0).
